criteria.description: The objective(s) are qualitative, ambitious, and time-bound — a destination, not a metric or a task.
Key results are measurable OUTCOMES (metrics that move with user behaviour), not a list of features to ship.
Each key result has a baseline and a target (from X to Y).
Explicitly connects the objective to the company goal (engagement).
Includes a guardrail/health metric so a KR can't be hit by breaking something else.
Avoids vanity metrics (raw totals that only go up) and avoids obviously sandbagged or fantasy targets; targets are stretch-but-plausible vs the baseline.
Keeps to a focused set (roughly 1-3 objectives, 3-5 KRs each) rather than an unfocused pile.
